question: In a certain code language, ‘CURVED’ is coded as ‘FWSUCA’ and ‘LONDON’ is coded as ‘OQOCMK’. How will ‘SIMPLE’ be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘CURVED’ is coded as ‘FWSUCA’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5698f3b710b890a69f61314a400214b053ea7b23c3800f9c7d2b5e39a43a84c.png] 

And,

‘LONDON’ is coded as ‘OQOCMK’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97ae49158529d6e8e6ad254c7a46a54172a9d9c5eab4e654f9a3fd3518195784.png] 

Similarly,

‘SIMPLE’ will be coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85f2de72c75d20bac581a46e6533ac7c420ba411beedfb1381d3945cffb811e5.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
